1.title: 概覽
content: 俄羅斯女強人亞歷珊卓拉・札莉雅諾娃完美結合了單打獨鬥與團隊合作。簡稱為 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的她，能運用自身力量扛起整個隊伍。玩家可以選擇配備自我防護與隊友防護的屏障，在團隊導向的玩法與「獨自一人」的自私打法之間進行切換。

![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的高傷害潛力使她能夠彌補隊伍中輸出表現不佳的情況。另一方面，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以將每個屏障都用在脆弱的隊友身上，藉此阻擋敵方攻勢並讓隊友創造出精彩表現。身為一名 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅擁有中等水準的傷害減免能力，且根據能量累積的狀況，她的輸出能力可能會成為所有 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克中最高或最低的。

1.1.1.title: 操作指南
content: * 僅在近距離主動攻擊敵人時對自己使用屏障，以建立並維持高能量。
* 應對性地使用你的防護力場來保護隊友，而非預先使用；優先選擇隊友明顯遭受攻擊的時刻，以最大化能量獲取與影響力。

* 配合隊友的後續絕招或爆發傷害來施放 ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）。即使只捕捉到一或兩名敵人，也足以贏得會戰。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 透過威脅性的爆發傷害或突襲，迫使她提早或在無效的情況下交出防護力場，隨後暫時脫離戰鬥。

* 留意她的能量等級。高能量的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅（Zarya）威脅性極高，因此在戰鬥中務必謹慎應對，並避免在她能量全滿時與她進行長時間的單挑。
* 當她擁有重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）時，避免隊友聚集在一起。選擇讓她難以鎖定你的位置，或保留防禦性技能來保護自己與隊友。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 具備單人凱瑞（Solo carry）潛力
* 中距離英雄
* 生存能力
* 需要高能量（High energy）
* 無位移能力
* 糟糕的防護屏障（Bubbles）會導致團戰失敗

3.1.1.title: 單人凱瑞潛力
content: 自私地使用防護罩來累積高能量，並確保自己存活，直到你在 100% 能量時達到每秒 175 點傷害。能量全滿的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以在 1.5 秒內融化任何 250 生命值的英雄！憑藉這種傷害潛力，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅總能找到獲勝的方法。此外，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障（Projected Barrier）拯救遠處的隊友，而無需放棄自己的站位或進攻節奏。

3.1.2.title: 中距離傷害
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya excels in mid-range engagements (10 - 20m). When facing off against a close range heroes (![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)Reaper, etc), she can play at her maximum range just outside of their optimal ranges. ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya doesn’t have to push up too far to put herself in range of pressuring enemies positioned behind their ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank. Secondary fire is also great for finishing off retreating enemies and its projectile speed is reliable at mid-range.

3.1.3.title: 生存能力
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的屏障能量機制迫使敵方隊伍必須迅速做出決策：是要嘗試摧毀屏障，進而給予 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅更多能量，還是要等待 2 秒屏障時間結束，讓她能自由地推進或撤退。這些互動使得要擊殺 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅變得非常困難。此外，護盾生命值與自我治療被動技能的結合，讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅能夠在掩體後方短暫躲避，並在沒有 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援角色的協助下快速恢復生命值。

3.2.1.title: 高度依賴維持高能量
content: 低能量的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅無法對任何人造成威脅，也幾乎無法施加壓力。當敵方隊伍避免攻擊你的屏障，導致你陷入低能量且沒有冷卻技能可用的狀態時，在屏障冷卻完畢前，你對隊伍幾乎沒有任何貢獻。一個被低能量 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅攻擊的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士，可以安全地直接無視她並摧毀她的隊友。

3.2.2.title: 缺乏機動性且難以應對遠程英雄
content: 位於據點外圍或高處的敵人對 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 來說極難處理。她可以對攻擊這些敵人的隊友施放 ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障（Projected Barrier），但除此之外能做的非常有限。雖然次要攻擊跳躍可以提供些許額外的垂直位移，但距離太短，不足以讓她抵達大多數的高處區域。

3.2.3.title: 幾個糟糕的防護力場（Particle Barrier/Projected Barrier）會導致團戰失利
content: 防護力場的最佳使用方式相當複雜，關於對誰、何時、何地以及如何使用防護力場的選擇，在整場比賽中會不斷變化。對一名你以為身陷險境但其實不然的隊友使用防護力場，會讓其他隊友完全暴露在危險之中。將防護力場用在抵擋一項敵方技能上，會使 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅容易受到另一項敵方技能的攻擊。若連續浪費兩次防護力場，通常意味著該場團戰已經失敗，你的隊伍必須重新調整節奏。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：粒子砲
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/319945fa8ef79cf6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-cannon.png)粒子砲使用技巧

* 當輸出型英雄與![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援型英雄進入射程範圍內時，請優先以光束攻擊他們；除非沒有更高價值的目標，否則不要輕易與敵方坦克交戰。
* 在光束射程的最外緣進行遊走，在維持壓力的同時將受到的傷害降至最低。

* 該光束無法被![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)招架，也無法被![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣或![](/data/assets/guide/7486123dd5edc842.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkinetic-grasp.png)動能掌握吸收，這使其在面對這些英雄時相當可靠。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：能量榴彈（Energy Grenades）
content: **能量榴彈（Energy Grenades）使用技巧**
* 當目標超出光束射程時，請使用次要攻擊來壓制聚集的敵人並累積絕招能量。
* 將次要攻擊穿插在彈藥循環中以最大化整體傷害輸出，特別是在彈匣即將耗盡時。

* 在近距離下，次要攻擊接近戰攻擊是 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅傷害最高的爆發連段。
* 即使剩餘彈藥極少，你仍然可以發射一枚次要投射物。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：粒子屏障（自我防護罩）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/81b1062b5b25f966.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-barrier.png)粒子屏障（Particle Barrier）的使用技巧
* 當你正在承受傷害或準備強勢推進時，請以反應式的方式使用自我防護罩，而不是預先施放。
* 試著在明顯的進攻時刻使用防護罩——例如當你成為敵方技能的目標，或是向前壓制對手時。
* 避免在對峙階段過早使用自我防護罩，否則當防護罩進入冷卻時間而敵人再次發動攻勢時，你會變得非常脆弱。

4.4.title: [E]：投射屏障（隊友護盾）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障的技巧**
* 對承受巨大壓力或正準備採取激進攻勢的隊友施放護盾。

* 使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障來協助隊伍進行潛水（dive）、側襲（flank）或前線推進（frontline push），否則這些行動很容易遭到懲罰。
* 優先保護被敵方包夾的隊友，因為一個時機精準的護盾完全可以扭轉戰局。

4.4.1.title: 防護力場管理哲學
content: * 優先使用反應式防護力場而非預判式，因為針對已確認的傷害進行應對，比猜測敵方的時機點更為穩定。
* 根據戰鬥節奏決定是要提早累積能量，還是採取嚴謹的冷卻時間循環——提早使用防護力場可以累積能量，但會拖慢戰鬥節奏；而保留防護力場則能在戰鬥中期提供更強的應對能力。
* 請務必留意，兩個防護力場共用冷卻時間，因此若其中一個使用效率不佳，將會限制你整體的防禦靈活性。

4.5.title: [Q] 重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）的技巧**
* 你不需要一次命中多個目標的絕招也能贏得會戰；確保擊殺一名高價值目標通常就已足夠。

* 在施放絕招前，請先追蹤敵方的反制絕招與減傷手段，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）、![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)冰牆（Ice Wall）、![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)超凡入聖（Transcendence）以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)音波屏障（Sound Barrier）。
* 在進行長距離投擲重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）之前，請先使用次要攻擊來測量投射物的拋物線與射程。
* 重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）可以附著在任何表面上，將敵人懸浮在離地面些許的高度，可以讓你的隊友更容易進行後續的傷害輸出。

4.6.title: 能量（被動機制）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/385129e8606db3b6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy.png)能量的使用技巧**
* 你的屏障所吸收的傷害會提高主要攻擊與次要攻擊的傷害。
* 若你沒有在減免傷害，能量便會衰減，因此請維持戰鬥節奏以保持高充能狀態。
* 高能量會大幅提升你的威脅等級，因此站位與屏障的使用時機應圍繞在維持有效充能，同時避免過度深入戰場。

5.1.1.title: 偵查者（Spotter）
5.1.1.description: 投射屏障（Projected Barrier）會啟動盟友的生命恢復效果，並使其移動速度提升 20%。
content: * 對於強化盟友而言極其強大。提供治療並給予速度加成，能讓你的隊友成為主宰戰局的關鍵。

5.1.2.title: 跳躍強化（Jump-Ups）
5.1.2.description: 次要攻擊的自我擊退效果提升 75%。
content: * 最適合在高地地形豐富的地圖使用。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅（Zarya）通常在這些地圖上會感到吃力，但額外的跳躍高度為她提供了更多的機動性選擇。

5.2.1.title: 能量長槍（Energy Lance）
5.2.1.description: 粒子砲（Particle Cannon）的光束可以穿透敵人。
content: * 最適合用來對付喜歡聚在一起的戰鬥型陣容。瞄準後方的敵人，並調整角度，讓最前方的敵人也保持在光束的路徑上。

5.2.2.title: 額外衝擊（Extra Oomph）
5.2.2.description: 當屏障（Barrier）啟動時，使用粒子砲（Particle Cannon）的射束造成傷害可產生能量。
content: * 停止能量衰減，且比單純承受傷害能累積更多的總能量。當敵方隊伍很聰明、試圖不讓你充能時，這項能力非常實用。

6.1.1.title: 南極半島
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅在控制（Control）地圖上通常表現優異，因為大多數這類地圖並不適合長距離交戰。在南極半島上，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅缺乏機動性的弱點並不會妨礙她發揮價值。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅幾乎總能在三個目標點的每一個點位中，強迫戰鬥發生在她的最佳射程範圍內。此外，這張地圖上的高處區域也都在![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的有效射程內，使她成為絕佳的選擇。

6.1.2.title: 里亞爾托
content: * 雖然里亞爾托有幾個視野較長的區域，但也有大量的掩體供 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 使用。在防守推進時，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 可以利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/81b1062b5b25f966.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-barrier.png)粒子屏障（Particle Barrier）在掩體間推進。同樣地，在防守時，當面臨壓力或屏障冷卻中，大多數區域都有附近的掩體可以躲避，待狀態恢復後再出來爭奪空間。

6.1.3.title: 灕江天塔
content: * 與南極半島類似，這張地圖的架構與 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的技能組非常契合。戰鬥焦點被迫集中在據點上，而這正是 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅最強勢的地方。![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）是清空控制據點的最佳絕招之一，因為多名敵人在爭奪據點時往往會聚集在同一個區域。

6.2.1.title: 好萊塢
content: * 好萊塢的每個據點都有太多長距離的視線範圍和高台，導致 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅很難持續發揮作用。如果敵方有 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西待在後方壓制你們全隊，那 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅基本上只能眼睜睜看著這一切發生，並試圖在正面戰場上智取對手。

6.2.2.title: 新皇后街
content: * 為了讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅發揮成效，她基本上不能一直待在機器人旁邊。新皇后街是《鬥陣特攻2》中最開闊的地圖之一。在地圖的幾乎每個區域，敵方隊伍全體都能站位在 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的攻擊範圍之外。如果她過度前壓去對付敵人，就會讓後排隊友在目標點上暴露無遺。這會導致戰鬥在兩個不同的戰線同時展開，並要求你的隊伍必須同時贏下兩場戰鬥。

6.2.3.title: 蘇拉瓦薩
content: * 閃擊點地圖蘇拉瓦薩（Suravasa）的涵蓋範圍對 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 來說太過廣大。目標點之間的距離非常分散，導致敵隊幾乎總能在 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 抵達前就佔據有利位置。此外，目標點的視野非常開闊，這使得 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 必須依賴自身的防護屏障來維持生存，且在受到壓力時難以利用掩體進行防守。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅在鬥陣（brawl）陣容與機動（dive）陣容中都能有不錯的表現，但在面對消耗（poke）陣容或與其搭配時則較為吃力。

以 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅為核心的鬥陣陣容，主要由近距離英雄組成，他們會集體行動，試圖在承受消耗傷害的同時存活下來，並設法強迫敵人進行近距離交戰。
**強勢的札莉雅鬥陣陣容範例**

![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅、![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美、![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神、![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)路西歐、![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)莫伊拉

搭配 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的機動陣容，會有數名輸出（DPS）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援（Support）隊友對敵方後排發動激進的攻勢。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅在機動陣容中扮演兩種角色之一。主要任務是為激進的隊友施放屏障（bubble），保護他們免受控場技能（crowd control abilities）的影響，並為他們提供額外的 225 點生命值。另一種協助機動隊友的方式是維持自身的生存能力。利用掩體和自我屏障，讓隊伍的其他資源能專注於機動交戰，而不必分心去維持 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的生命值。
**強勢的札莉雅機動陣容範例**

![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅、![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏、![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光、![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子、![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜

7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人協同效應
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏

* 除了![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)奈米強化（Nano Boost）之外，![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障（Projected Barrier）是給予![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏玩家最好的技能。![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏需要深入敵陣後方大肆破壞。他很怕控場技能，任何控場技能命中![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏通常都意味著他的死亡。![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障能提供暫時的控場免疫，讓敵人難以應對![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏。在![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)龍一文字（Dragonblade）期間施放屏障幾乎保證能至少擊殺一名敵人。
![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)半藏

* 經典的「重力龍」組合至今仍是最佳的絕招連技之一。唯一能真正反制重力龍的方法是![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)禪亞塔的![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)超凡入聖（Transcendence），但這個反制手段本身也能被反制。如果![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅能用![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）吸住兩名或以上的敵人，這個連技幾乎就宣告了勝利。
![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜

* ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜的治療能讓![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅進行極度激進的打法。生化手榴彈（Anti-Nade）的禁療效果也能幫助擊殺那些沒有禁療效果時![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)札莉雅難以擊敗的![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)坦克。對高能量的![](/data/assets/guide/9db85f17ed9127be.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnano-boost.png)札莉雅施放![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)奈米強化（Nano Boost）簡直能摧毀敵方隊伍。大多數英雄即使看到發光的![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅衝過來，也無法跑得夠快。此外，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅可以透過時機精準的![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)投射屏障，從敵方![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)側襲者（Flanker）手中救下![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)安娜（安娜對這類英雄較為弱勢）。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 無論身處哪個副角色（subrole），反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的主要方式就是避免讓她獲得能量，並找出她使用防護罩的規律。如果她總是提早使用防護罩，那就等效果結束後再發動攻勢。如果 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅一看到隊友被盯上就驚慌地給予防護罩，那就轉而攻擊 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅本人，因為她現在已經沒有防護罩可以保護自己了。有時候，短暫撤退並重新調整位置可以讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/385129e8606db3b6.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy.png)能量（Energy）開始衰退，這能讓你的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank）在重新爭奪目標時承受較少的傷害。

8.1.title: 特定英雄剋制關係
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔

* 無論 ![](/data/assets/guide/acd524155a25802e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcharge.png)札莉雅的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)能量（Charge）有多高，只要有 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援（Supports）在治療拉瑪塔，他在格擋時就不會被擊殺。![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅也很難從拉瑪塔身上獲取能量，因為他可以輕易地在屏障（bubbles）期間使用護盾或格擋。憑藉 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）的速度加成以及渦流（Vortex）的緩速效果，當 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅試圖在屏障冷卻間隙撤退到掩體後方時，拉瑪塔可以輕鬆追擊。
![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)奪命女

* ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅對於厲害的 ![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)奪命女完全沒有反制手段。顯然，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅無法在遠距離擊殺奪命女，且 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅也無法可靠地協助隊友在奪命女的威脅下存活。
![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美

* ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美對 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的剋制取決於誰的操作更勝一籌。如果 ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)冰牆（Ice Wall）將 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅與她的隊伍隔開，這幾乎保證能完成擊殺，或者至少能用你的一個冷卻技能換掉對方的兩個屏障，以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援（Supports）大量技能。![](/data/assets/guide/6f0829d84c10e9e2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fendothermic-blaster.png)吸熱噴射槍（Endothermic Blaster）的緩速效果對於沒有自我屏障可用的 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅來說是極強的懲罰。對 ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美而言，危險在於如果她的 ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)冰牆（Ice Wall）施放失誤，![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅的近距離傷害將遠超 ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美的近距離主要攻擊。
![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)巴帝斯特

* 面對 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅足以贏下會戰的絕招，只需在轉角處放置一個 ![](/data/assets/guide/3adb743da6c064fe.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fimmortality-field.png)維生力場（Immortality Field）就能保住全隊性命。![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)巴帝斯特的遠程消耗傷害也高到足以逼出屏障。當你對試圖進攻敵方 ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)巴帝斯特的隊友施放屏障時，他擁有太多的生存工具，很可能不會被擊敗，而你則會損失一個屏障。
